A fix for Telescope closing right after the splash screen on some Windows laptops.

## Fixed

- On some Windows laptops with two graphics cards, 5.1.1 closed right after the splash screen. Telescope now picks the graphics card more carefully and moves on to the next one if a card doesn't work.
- Turning on **Values** in the colour picker near the top of the window no longer moves the switch away from your cursor either.

## Changed

- When a hot phone pauses the camera, the desktop says so under the heat warning instead of just showing a frozen picture.
